hard_required.meaning: Contract address, deployed bytecode+code hash and Midnight address in Base chain at target block. A Solidity source with deployment instructions is not proof of deployed bytecode.
Canonical inclusion, status success, full Resolve log (caller, marketHash, units, profit in raw loan-token units), exact gasUsed/effectiveGasPrice and all token/native transfers.
Loan-token ERC20 address/decimals, owner of caller/smart account, actual NQC beneficiary and any withdrawals. Source contract profit transfer alone not NQC P&L.
Both takeable sides, sizes, offer expiries/ratifier signatures, fees, timing, competition; independent before-the-fact source that could be captured without hindsight.
ETH/gas sponsor actually committed, gas and CREATE covered, KYC/credits/billing, no personal recourse, partial reverts, no implicit project-billed liabilities.
Inclusion payment, gas, sponsor markup, failure costs and net realized NQC cash ledger for outcome.

first_decision: If a verifiable settled Resolve gross profit fails to cover costs (when expressed with authenticated conversions), reject that instance; if not enough evidence, maintain UNKNOWN.
chain_requirement: Base 8453 only per current official bot, not Ethereum 1, Robinhood 4663, or synthetic 31337
source_restrictions: No prior denied API retries, no alternative proxies to bypass denial, no RPC, no new account or paid data without new user authorization
